title: metadata: resetting a published overlay on a packaged view answers reset:true, but the view LIST reads and the end-user list keep serving the overlay's expanded view items until restart
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: #23104 · studio-authoring.packaged-display-class-direct-edit · A3 (and its negative N1, the same defect)

**Reader who acts:** the seat owning `packages/metadata-protocol` (triage routes). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "view overlay reset delete stale expanded view items list endpoint still serves overlay until restart registry heal" — 5 hits, all closed and none this shape; the nearest family members are #5079 (a deleted overlay lingering in the `/meta` listing) and #6853 (the heal not re-registering a packaged contributor definition).

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of #23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, admin persona. Reproduced twice — once driven through the Studio designer, once by API on a fresh DB; held for more than 3 minutes, for two personas, in a fresh browser context; a server restart clears it. The dashboard leg of the same item resets cleanly. No console code is involved.

## Reproduction (admin bearer, fresh boot)

1. `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task` → take the item (strip the `_`-prefixed keys), set `list.label` to `All Tasks (X)` and drop the `progress` column; `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task?mode=draft` with that body → 200; `POST /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task/publish` `{}` → 200.
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/view` → `showcase_task.default` reads `All Tasks (X)`, 6 columns — expected.
3. `DELETE /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task` → 200 `{success: true, reset: true}`.
4. `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` → `All Tasks`, 7 columns (correct), **but** `GET /api/v1/meta/view` and `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=showcase_task` still serve `showcase_task.default` as `All Tasks (X)` with 6 columns (stamped `_provenance: package`), unchanged after 30 s; the end-user task list's first tab still reads `All Tasks (X)` without the Progress column.

**Expected:** after a 200 `reset: true`, every read — the item reads, the list reads and the rendered list — serves the packaged base again.

## Likely mechanism (objectstack `main`, to be confirmed by the fixing seat)

On publish, `hydrateExpandedViewItems` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) registers the container's expanded view items (`OBJECT.VIEWKEY`, here `showcase_task.default`) in the process registry. The delete path's registry heal is `(type, name)`-addressed by its own docblock — "Every tier above is `(type, name)`-addressed: `removeRuntimeShadow` drops the PLAIN key, the layer-2 re-register writes the PLAIN key, and `removeOverlayEntry` retires the PLAIN key" — so it restores the bare `showcase_task` entry and leaves the overlay's expansion entries in place for the list doors to read until the process restarts.
